N=9
# Backtracking with candidates
rows=[set(range(1,10)) for _ in range(9)]
cols=[set(range(1,10)) for _ in range(9)]
boxes=[set(range(1,10)) for _ in range(9)]
grid=[0]*81
ok=True
for idx,v in givens.items():
    r=idx//9;c=idx%9;b=(r//3)*3+c//3
    if v not in rows[r] or v not in cols[c] or v not in boxes[b]:
        ok=False; print('conflict',idx,v)
    grid[idx]=v; rows[r].remove(v); cols[c].remove(v); boxes[b].remove(v)

nodes=0
def solve():
    global nodes
    nodes+=1
    # find unassigned with min candidates
    best=None; bc=None
    for i in range(81):
        if grid[i]==0:
            r=i//9;c=i%9;b=(r//3)*3+c//3
            cand=rows[r]&cols[c]&boxes[b]
            if not cand:
                return False
            if bc is None or len(cand)<len(bc):
                best=i; bc=cand
                if len(cand)==1: break
    if best is None: return True
    r=best//9;c=best%9;b=(r//3)*3+c//3
    for v in sorted(bc):
        grid[best]=v; rows[r].remove(v); cols[c].remove(v); boxes[b].remove(v)
        if solve(): return True
        rows[r].add(v); cols[c].add(v); boxes[b].add(v); grid[best]=0
    return False
